-- The client says: Provide values to adjust the hit testing area for nameplates. Positive values will decrease the hit test area, negative values will increase it. Note that all hit testing is clamped to the bounds of the nameplate and can not be moved outside it.
C_NamePlateManager.SetNamePlateHitTestInsets(type, left, right, top, bottom)
note: A possible call shaped from the signature. The comment quotes the client description. This is not a script from Blizzard.
